title: Gaussian processes for real-time urban traffic estimation using a fleet of drones
abstract: arXiv:2611.14536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time urban traffic monitoring is essential for modern city management, yet conventional static sensors provide only limited spatial coverage. Autonomous drone fleets can complement this infrastructure by offering flexible, high-resolution mobile sensing across different parts of the network. This paper introduces a spatio-temporal Gaussian process (GP) framework for reconstructing network-wide traffic states from partial aerial observations. The model accounts for the physical structure of the road network through a graph Mat\'ern kernel, which embeds network topology into the spatial covariance structure, and captures temporal dependencies through an exponential temporal kernel. Within this framework, historical loop detector data provide an informative prior mean that is updated in real time using incoming drone observations, yielding network-wide point estimates together with predictive uncertainty. translated_title: 基于无人机编队的实时城市交通估计高斯过程方法
translated_abstract: 实时城市交通监测对现代城市管理至关重要，然而传统固定式传感器仅能提供有限的空间覆盖范围。自主无人机编队能够通过网络不同区域的灵活、高分辨率移动感知来补充这一基础设施。本文提出了一种时空高斯过程（GP）框架，用于从部分的空中观测数据中重建全网交通状态。该模型通过图Matérn核来刻画道路网络的物理结构，将网络拓扑嵌入空间协方差结构中，并通过指数时间核捕捉时间依赖性。在该框架中，历史环形检测器数据提供了信息丰富的先验均值，并通过实时传入的无人机观测数据进行更新，从而产生全网范围的点估计以及预测不确定性。我们在……中对该框架进行了验证。
tldr: 本文提出一种融合图Matérn核与指数时间核的时空高斯过程框架，将历史检测器数据作为先验、以无人机实时观测进行更新，从而从部分空中观测中重建全网交通状态及其预测不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spatio-temporal Gaussian process framework combining a graph Matérn kernel and an exponential temporal kernel, which uses historical loop detector data as an informative prior updated in real time by drone observations to reconstruct network-wide traffic states with predictive uncertainty.
